info.title: Shillinq Register
info.description: Register containing all schemas for the Shillinq application.

x-openregister.description: Shillinq — open-source business administration suite for Dutch SMB, ZZP, and government.

example.title: Example
example.description: Example schema — replace with your app's actual schemas.

title.description: The title of the example object

Account.title: Account
Account.description: A hierarchical chart-of-accounts entry conforming to the RGS (Referentie Grootboek Schema) standard for Dutch bookkeeping.

accountNumber.description: RGS-style account code (e.g. '1000', '4100'). Unique within an administration.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this account's base currency.

parentAccountNumber.description: FK to the parent Account.accountNumber for hierarchy navigation.

isClosingAccount.description: Designates this as the administration's single closing account for period-end equity absorption.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this account. Scopes uniqueness of accountNumber.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state of the account.

description.description: Operator-authored free-text description of the account.

vatApplicable.description: Whether VAT/BTW applies to transactions posted to this account.

active.label: Active
active.description: Fully usable for new GL postings.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable and referenceable by existing postings, but rejected as the target of new GL lines.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only — no new postings, no edits; remains queryable.

block.label: Block account
block.description: Prevent new postings against this account.

unblock.label: Unblock account
unblock.description: Re-enable new postings against this account.

archiveFromActive.label: Archive account
archiveFromActive.description: Move to historical archive. Requires zero open balance.

archiveFromBlocked.label: Archive account
archiveFromBlocked.description: Move to historical archive from blocked state. Requires zero open balance.

isSchatkistAccount.description: REQ-SBK-002: marks this account as a Treasury (schatkistbankieren) account so its postings are aggregated into the daily SchatkistPosition. Default false; non-government administrations leave it false.

x-openregister-lifecycle-retention.description: REQ-ARC-005: Account masterdata retained indefinitely per Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020 §5.1.1 (keep_indefinite). Enforcement is OR's per ADR-022.

VatReturn.title: VAT Return (BTW-aangifte)
VatReturn.description: A periodic VAT return (BTW-aangifte) per Wet OB 1968. REQ-VBTW-001/002. Lifecycle draft → submitted → accepted → corrected. SBR/Digipoort submission consumes the digipoort-sbr OpenConnector source per ADR-019/ADR-022.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this return.

periodYear.description: Calendar year of the return period.

state.description: Lifecycle state of the VAT return.

amount.description: Server-authoritative total VAT liability (MonetaryAmount). Derived from the rubrieken aggregation; never trusted from the client.

attachmentUri.description: REQ-ARC: docudesk reference to the rendered aangifte PDF.

submit.label: Indienen via Digipoort
submit.description: REQ-VBTW-005/006/010: file the return. Requires approval above the operator threshold; triggers the digipoort-sbr submission workflow.

approval-workflow.description: REQ-VBTW-006: approval gate when liability exceeds an operator-configurable threshold (ADR-022 approval abstraction).

rubrieken.description: REQ-VBTW-004: VAT buckets grouped by rate (21%, 9%, 0%, reverse-charge) over GL postings in the return period, summing debit/credit per rate. Server-authoritative — drives the amount field.

reverseChargeBucket.description: REQ-VBTW-009: reverse-charge (verleggingsregeling) postings aggregated separately per Wet OB 1968.

x-openregister-lifecycle-retention.description: REQ-ARC-003/005: 7-year financial-record retention, disposition archive. Enforced by OR.

IcpStatement.title: ICP Statement (ICP-opgaaf)
IcpStatement.description: Intra-community supplies declaration (ICP-opgaaf) per REQ-VBTW-007. Lifecycle draft → submitted → accepted.

icpTransactions.description: REQ-VBTW-007: intra-community supply line totals aggregated from GL for the period.

VatCorrection.title: VAT Correction (Suppletie)
VatCorrection.description: VAT correction submission (suppletie-aangifte) per REQ-VBTW-008. Lifecycle draft → submitted → accepted.

periodType.description: Filing cadence of the period being corrected.

periodYear.description: Calendar year of the corrected period.

originalReturnId.description: FK to the VatReturn being corrected.

originalReturn.description: REQ-VBTW-008: the VatReturn this correction supersedes.

VatTariff.title: VAT Tariff (BTW-tarief)
VatTariff.description: A statutory VAT rate (BTW-tarief) per Wet OB 1968, seeded from btw-tariffs-2026.json. REQ-VBTW-003.

rgsAccountHint.description: Hint of the RGS account this rate posts to.

x-openregister-lifecycle-retention.description: REQ-ARC: statutory tariff masterdata retained indefinitely (keep).

BbvAccountMapping.title: BBV Account Mapping
BbvAccountMapping.description: Maps an RGS account to a BBV taakveld for municipal administrations per Besluit BBV bijlage IV. REQ-BBV-002. Operator-overrideable; (administrationId, accountNumber) is unique.

taakveld.description: BBV taakveld code from bbv-taakvelden-2024.json seed.

bcfCompensable.description: REQ-BBV-002/REQ-BCF-003: whether VAT on postings to this account is BCF-compensable.

compensablePercentage.description: REQ-BCF-005: compensable percentage 0-100 for partial-recovery scenarios.

iv3Bucket.description: REQ-BBV-008: CBS IV3-bestand bucket identifier for deterministic IV3 export aggregation.

unique.description: REQ-BBV-002: one mapping per account per administration.

account.description: REQ-BBV-002: the RGS account this mapping classifies.

byTaakveld.description: REQ-BBV-007: GL postings grouped by taakveld for period-end roll-up reporting.

BbvTaakveld.title: BBV Taakveld
BbvTaakveld.description: A BBV activity category (taakveld) per Besluit BBV bijlage IV, seeded from bbv-taakvelden-2024.json. REQ-BBV-004.

programmaFocus.description: Hint of the BBV programma this taakveld belongs to.

x-openregister-lifecycle-retention.description: REQ-ARC: taakveld catalogue masterdata retained indefinitely (keep).

Iv3Export.title: IV3 Export
Iv3Export.description: Quarterly IV3 export to CBS per Statistische en Inlichtingendienst IV3-bestand specificaties. REQ-IV3-001/002. Lifecycle draft → generated → submitted → accepted (+ early correction).

administrationId.description: FK to the gemeente Administration (carries the CBS gemeente code).

attachmentUri.description: docudesk reference to the generated IV3 XML artifact.

submit.label: Indienen bij CBS
submit.description: REQ-IV3-005/006: submit via the cbs-iv3 OpenConnector source.

buckets.description: REQ-IV3-003: GL postings grouped by BbvAccountMapping.iv3Bucket, summing amounts per bucket for the quarter. Server-authoritative.

iv3Xml.description: REQ-IV3-004: declarative transformation from aggregated buckets to CBS IV3 XML structure via OR's mapping engine (no bespoke PHP rendering).

BcfClaim.title: BCF Claim
BcfClaim.description: BTW-compensatiefonds claim per Wet HOF. REQ-BCF-001/002. Lifecycle draft → submitted → accepted → settled. Quarterly submission via the digikoppeling-bcf OpenConnector source.

totalClaimAmount.description: Server-authoritative claim total (MonetaryAmount), derived from the compensableVatByAccount aggregation. Never trusted from the client.

attachmentUri.description: docudesk reference to the claim PDF.

submit.label: Indienen
submit.description: REQ-BCF-006/009: submit the claim. Requires approval above the operator threshold.

approval-workflow.description: REQ-BCF-009: approval gate above an operator-configurable threshold (ADR-022).

compensableVatByAccount.description: REQ-BCF-004: SUM(GLLine.amount × BbvAccountMapping.compensablePercentage) for postings where BbvAccountMapping.bcfCompensable = true in the claim period. Server-authoritative — drives totalClaimAmount.

KorRegime.title: KOR Regime
KorRegime.description: Kleine OndernemersRegeling (KOR) status per administration per Wet OB 1968 art. 25. REQ-KOR-001. Lifecycle outside → opted-in → threshold-warning → threshold-exceeded → opted-out.

ytdRevenue.description: Server-authoritative YTD revenue (derived, see x-openregister-calculations). Never trusted from the client.

opted-out.label: KOR beeindigd
opted-out.description: Exited KOR; reverts to standard VAT filing.

optIn.label: Opt-in KOR
optIn.description: REQ-KOR-002: operator elects the KOR exemption.

warn.label: Drempelwaarschuwing
warn.description: REQ-KOR-002/005: auto-transition when ytdRevenue >= 80% of threshold.

requires.description: REQ-KOR-004: cross-period YTD revenue aggregation. ADR-031 exception — OR's declarative aggregation cannot span fiscal periods inside a requires clause (Risk 3); single-method PHP guard, no state.

exceed.label: Drempel overschreden
exceed.description: REQ-KOR-002/005: auto-transition when ytdRevenue >= 100% of threshold.

requires.description: REQ-KOR-004: cross-period YTD revenue aggregation. ADR-031 exception (Risk 3).

optOut.label: Opt-out KOR
optOut.description: REQ-KOR-002/006: exit KOR. Creates a JournalEntry in state pending (NOT auto-posted) for operator + accountant review.

ytdRevenue.description: REQ-KOR-004: aggregate Invoice (T2 AR) revenue for the current calendar year. Declarative form; the cross-period sum inside the lifecycle requires is served by KorThresholdGuard per the ADR-031 exception.

thresholdWarning.description: REQ-KOR-005/010: warning notification at 80% of the omzetdrempel.

thresholdExceeded.description: REQ-KOR-005/010: alarm notification at 100% of the omzetdrempel.

korProgress.description: REQ-KOR-009: dashboard progress bar (0-100%) of ytdRevenue against thresholdAmount for opted-in administrations.
korProgress.title: KOR-drempel

UrenRegistratie.title: Urenregistratie
UrenRegistratie.description: Billable-hour tracking for ZZP urencriterium (Wet IB 2001 art. 3.6) and consultancy project accounting. REQ-ZZP-001.

category.description: Hour category. Excluded hours do not count toward the 1225-urencriterium.

excludedReason.description: REQ-ZZP-002: required when category=excluded; per Wet IB 2001 these hours do not count toward the urencriterium.

urencriteriumProgress.description: REQ-KOR/ZZP: dashboard tracker for YTD qualifying hours against the 1225 threshold.
urencriteriumProgress.title: Urencriterium

ZzpDeduction.title: ZZP Deduction
ZzpDeduction.description: ZZP tax deduction eligibility per Wet IB 2001 (zelfstandigenaftrek, startersaftrek, MKB-winstvrijstelling). REQ-ZZP-004.

ytdQualifyingHours.description: Server-authoritative YTD qualifying hours (derived). Never trusted from the client.

REQ-ZZP-003: SUM(UrenRegistratie.hours) where category != excluded for the calendar year. Declarative form; the cross-period sum inside a lifecycle requires is served by UrencriteriumGuard per the ADR-031 exception (Risk 3).

ytdQualifyingHoursGuard.description: REQ-ZZP-003: cross-period qualifying-hours sum. ADR-031 exception — OR's declarative aggregation cannot span fiscal periods inside a requires clause (Risk 3); single-method PHP guard, no state.

IbAangifteExport.title: IB-aangifte Export
IbAangifteExport.description: Inkomstenbelasting (IB) aangifteformulier export preparation per REQ-ZZP-007.

totalIncome.description: Server-authoritative income from GL revenue aggregation.

attachmentUri.description: docudesk reference to the export PDF.

SchatkistPosition.title: Schatkist Position
SchatkistPosition.description: Daily aggregated Treasury (schatkistbankieren) position per Wet HOF. REQ-SBK-003. NOT a parallel ledger — a derived daily view over schatkist-flagged accounts.

position.description: Server-authoritative aggregated position (derived from flagged accounts). Never trusted from the client.

drempelbedragApplies.description: Whether the drempelbedrag applies for this administration size.

position.description: REQ-SBK-004: SUM of GLLine postings on accounts where isSchatkistAccount=true for the business day, computed end-of-day. Server-authoritative.

thresholdCrossing.description: REQ-SBK-008: alert the treasurer when position > drempelbedragAmount.

Subsidie.title: Subsidie
Subsidie.description: Grant (subsidie) administration per ASV-model + Awb 4.2. REQ-SUB-001/002. Lifecycle aanvraag → verleend → (ingetrokken/gewijzigd) → vastgesteld → uitbetaald → teruggevorderd → afbetalingsregeling.

attachmentUri.description: docudesk reference to the beschikking/award document.

verleen.label: Verlenen
verleen.description: REQ-SUB-003/004: award the grant. Requires approval.

approval-workflow.description: REQ-SUB-004: approval gate on grant award (ADR-022).

uitbetalen.label: Uitbetalen
uitbetalen.description: REQ-SUB-003/005: disburse. Creates a balanced JournalEntry in state pending (operator approval required before posting).

afbetalen.label: Afbetalingsregeling
afbetalen.description: REQ-SUB-003/009: agree a settlement plan with RepaymentInstallment records.

installments.description: REQ-SUB-007/009: settlement-plan instalments for a teruggevorderd subsidie.

x-openregister-lifecycle-retention.description: REQ-ARC-003/005: 10 years after settlement, disposition archive.

RepaymentInstallment.title: Repayment Installment
RepaymentInstallment.description: A single instalment of a subsidie settlement plan (afbetalingsregeling) per REQ-SUB-007.

subsidieId.description: FK to the Subsidie being repaid.

x-openregister-lifecycle-retention.description: REQ-ARC: retained with the parent subsidie (10 years after settlement).

RetentionRule.title: Retention Rule
RetentionRule.description: A records-retention rule per Archiefwet 1995 + Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020, seeded by Shillinq and consumed by OR's lifecycle retention engine per ADR-022. REQ-ARC-002. Enforcement (purge/archive/anonymise) is OR's responsibility.

administrationId.description: FK when this rule is a per-administration override (REQ-ARC-008); null for the seeded default.

retentionYears.description: Retention period in years; null for indefinite.

disposition.description: What happens when the retention period elapses.

unique.description: REQ-ARC-008: one rule per code per administration (null administration = seeded default).

Project.title: Project
Project.description: A consultancy project with RJ 270 / IFRS 15 percentage-of-completion revenue recognition. REQ-CPA-001. Lifecycle offerte → active → on-hold → closed → archived.

estimatedCost.description: Operator-set total estimated cost for RJ 270.

costIncurredToDate.description: Server-authoritative cost-to-date (derived aggregation). Never trusted from the client.
REQ-CPA-007: SUM(GLLine.amount) for cost accounts tagged to this project. Server-authoritative.

profitLoss.description: REQ-CPA-010: project P&L — GLLine sum filtered by project FK.

recognisedRevenue.description: REQ-CPA-007: RJ 270 §3.2.4 cost-to-cost percentage-of-completion: contractValue × (costIncurredToDate / estimatedCost).

x-openregister-lifecycle-retention.description: REQ-ARC-003/005: 7 years after closure, disposition archive.

ProjectAssignment.title: Project Assignment
ProjectAssignment.description: Resource allocation to a project per REQ-CPA-003.

project.description: REQ-CPA-003: the project this assignment belongs to.

RateCard.title: Rate Card
RateCard.description: Billing rate per seniority level, effective-dated. REQ-CPA-004. Seeded from rate-card-templates.json.

effectiveTo.description: Date the rate expires; null for current.

BillableHour.title: Billable Hour
BillableHour.description: A project billable-hour line extending UrenRegistratie, with the rate snapshotted at work-date per RJ 270 §3.2.4. REQ-CPA-006/009.

recognisedRate.description: REQ-CPA-009: MonetaryAmount snapshotted at the work-date from the effective RateCard. Locked at write time — not recomputed at invoice date.

project.description: REQ-CPA-006: the project this hour is billed to.

WipBalance.title: WIP Balance
WipBalance.description: A period-end work-in-progress snapshot per project per REQ-CPA-008. Generated by a ScheduledWorkflow triggered by T2's period-close.

wipBalance.description: REQ-CPA-008: cost incurred minus recognised revenue.

project.description: REQ-CPA-008: the project this snapshot belongs to.
